name: Wellbeing Check-In
description: A short, non-clinical self-reflection survey focused on general emotional strain and stress over the past two weeks.
instructions: This short check-in asks about how you’ve been feeling over the past two weeks. There are no right or wrong answers. This is not a diagnosis or medical assessment.

questions.text: Depression – A persistently low or down mood (for example, not taking pleasure in things you normally do)?
Anger – Increased anger and irritability in general?
Mania – Feeling energized despite having not slept much?
Mania – Beginning new projects and an increased propensity to take risks?
Anxiety – Feeling consistently nervous, anxious, panicked, or frightened?
Anxiety – Deliberately avoiding situations that trigger anxiety or nervousness?
Somatic Symptoms – Experiencing aches or bodily pain that seem not to have a specific cause?
Suicidal Tendencies – Feeling suicidal or okay with not existing, or thoughts of self-harm?
Psychosis – Hearing things that others are not able to hear (e.g., voices when you are alone)?
Psychosis – Thinking that someone else can hear your thoughts or you can hear theirs?
Sleep Problems – Difficulty with sleep that has affected your quality of sleep (for example, consistent inability to fall asleep)?
Memory – Difficulty remembering information such as important locations or internalizing new information?
Repetitive Thoughts – Feeling a compulsive need to perform the same tasks or mental tasks repeatedly (includes thinking the same thoughts)?
Dissociation – Feeling detached from yourself and your own experiences, or not feeling like anything is real?
Personality – Difficulty in understanding yourself and who you truly are?
Personality – Inability to form relationships with other people or ever feel close to them or comfortable with them?
Substance Use – Engaging in any of the following activities: drinking more than four times a day, smoking, or utilizing any non-prescribed drugs?
